card.name: Capital M starting a word
card.fires_on: The letter M (or m) when it begins a word after a break, mostly in all-caps warning headings or capitalized medical terms. Examples are MALIGNANCY, MUCOUS and Migratory.

modes.label: All-caps warning headings
modes.description: A lone M starting a word like MALIGNANCY or MUCOUS in capitalized boxed-warning text.
modes.example: WARNING: SERIOUS INFECTIONS, MORTALITY,<< M>>ALIGNANCY, MAJOR ADVERSE

modes.label: Capitalized medical term
modes.description: M beginning a word in a title-case section or condition name, such as Migratory or Mircera.

modes.label: Hyphenated mid-
modes.description: The m after a hyphen in a compound such as Mid-morning.
modes.example: Mid<<-m>>orning is usually a good time to poll

card.writes: The promoted tokens are about spring and march, which seems an unrelated side effect of the letter M, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires when a word begins with the letter M, mostly in capitalized warning headings.
